name: quantumgridos-advantage-evidence
description: Read-only review of quantum-versus-classical claims, experiment provenance, and engineering decisions

interface.shortDescription: Audit quantum claims with versioned evidence
interface.longDescription: Inspect local problem contracts, classical baselines, experiment manifests, decision gates, and evidence ledgers through a read-only MCP server, then review circuit boundaries, comparison fairness, and the narrowest supported action with a focused Skill.
defaultPrompt: Audit this quantum claim and identify the narrowest supported conclusion.
Compare these classical and quantum records under one task contract.
Trace this circuit from logical intent to a bounded engineering decision.
